t.METHYLPARABEN.agn: In the EU it may be used at up to 0.4% on its own and 0.8% in total with other parabens (as acid) (Annex V, entry 12). It is on the EU priority list of potential endocrine disruptors (group B); the list is not a verdict, it sets the order of assessment.
t.METHYLPARABEN.eff.0: Listed among substances to be assessed by the EU for possible effects on the hormone system; this entry holds no substance-specific conclusion from an agency.
t.METHYLPARABEN.k3.0: EU priority list of potential endocrine disruptors (group B). On the 28-substance priority list that the European Commission drew up in 2019 for potential endocrine disruptors in cosmetics (substances suspected of possibly affecting the hormone system), in Group B. The assessment of part of this group is ongoing; the status of substances that have been concluded is stated separately. The list is not a ruling; it shows the order of assessment.
t.METHYLPARABEN.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex V, entry 12: Permitted preservative, with an upper limit.
t.METHYLPARABEN.summary: A preservative from the paraben group.
t.METHYLPARABEN.what: Prevents the product from spoiling through bacteria and fungi.
